title: Color Only Challenge
description: Beat Minecraft after being assigned 1 of 10 colors. You can only break blocks that match your color, making every run chaotic and completely different.
body:
# Beat Minecraft, But You Can Only Break Your Color

A Minecraft challenge mod where every player is assigned **1 color out of 10** — and once you get your color, you can **only break blocks that match your assigned color**.

Sounds simple… until you realize most of Minecraft is now off-limits.

## How It Works

At the start of the challenge, each player is assigned one color from a set of 11 possible colors.

Once your color is chosen, you are only allowed to break blocks that contain or match that color. Any block that does not match your assigned color cannot be broken.

Your goal is simple:

**Beat Minecraft while only breaking blocks that have your color.**

## The Challenge

Every color creates a completely different run.

Some colors might let you break useful blocks early on, while others can make basic survival extremely difficult. Mining, crafting, exploring, building, and reaching the End all become way more strategic.

You will need to think carefully before breaking anything, because most blocks in the world are now locked away from you.

## Example

If your assigned color is **green**, you can only break green blocks.

That means you may be able to break things like leaves, grass-related blocks, or other green blocks, but anything outside your colour is off-limits.

## Goal

Beat the Ender Dragon while following your colour restriction.

No breaking other colours.  
No shortcuts.  
No cheating.  
Good luck.

## Commands

/color Player [color] - assign any color to any player
/colorbound:debugwand - modify the color of any block you right click
/colorbound:items - modify the colors of any item
